title: Calculate and interpret a specific indirect effect

brief.text: Open the DeLone & McLean example (SYNTHETIC data) and run it with its settings (5,000 draws, seed 20261401). System quality (SYSQ) has no direct path to net benefits (NB) in this model; it reaches NB through use (USE) and user satisfaction (SAT).

tasks.prompt: Using the two path coefficients SYSQ → SAT and SAT → NB, calculate the specific indirect effect SYSQ → SAT → NB. Enter it with three decimals.
tasks.feedbackCorrect: Correct: the product of the two paths, which the effects table also lists.
tasks.feedbackWrong: Not the expected value. Multiply SYSQ → SAT by SAT → NB; do not add them, and do not use the total effect, which also contains the routes through USE.

tasks.prompt: Enter the lower limit of the 95% bootstrap interval of that specific indirect effect.
tasks.feedbackWrong: Not the expected value. Read the interval of the specific indirect effect SYSQ → SAT → NB, not of the total indirect effect of SYSQ on NB.

tasks.prompt: The total effect of SYSQ on NB (≈ .19) is larger than the specific indirect effect via SAT. Why?

options.text: It sums all routes from SYSQ to NB: via SAT, via USE, and via USE then SAT.
options.feedback: Correct. Total = direct (none here) + every specific indirect effect.
Total and specific effects come from the same estimates; the difference is the number of routes.
Point estimates are computed on the original sample; resampling only provides intervals.

tasks.prompt: How should you classify the mediation of SYSQ → NB under Zhao et al. (2010)?

options.text: Indirect-only by design: the model fixes the direct path to zero, so the data were not allowed to show a direct effect; say so when reporting.
options.feedback: Correct. Without a direct path in the model, the classification rests on that specification.
Complementary requires a significant direct effect, which the model does not estimate.

options.text: No mediation, because there is no direct path.
options.feedback: Mediation is about the indirect effect, which is significant.

hints: A specific indirect effect follows one route; write down the arrows on that route.
The effects table distinguishes specific indirect effects from the total indirect and total effects.
Ask what the model allows: is there an arrow SYSQ → NB?

solution.text: SYSQ → SAT ≈ .284 and SAT → NB ≈ .464, so the specific indirect effect is ≈ .131, 95% CI ≈ [.090, .175]. The total effect of SYSQ on NB (≈ .189) adds the routes via USE (≈ .037) and via USE and SAT (≈ .020).
Because the model has no SYSQ → NB path, the result is indirect-only by specification. A test of complementary or competitive mediation would require estimating the direct path.
